name: zovo-regex-preview
displayName: Regex Preview & Regex Tester (Railroad Diagram Visualizer, Groups)
description: Regex preview and regex tester beside your code: click "Test regex" above a regex in JS, TS, Python, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Ruby or Rust. Capture groups, replace preview, railroad diagram visualizer, explain mode, flavor warnings. Free, no sign-in, works offline.

commands.title: Use File as Regex Sample Text

regexPreview.codeLens.description: Show "Test regex" above regexes in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, PHP and Ruby files. It is a CodeLens only: no language server and no TypeScript plugin.

regexPreview.codeLensMaxFileKB.description: Files larger than this (in KB) get no "Test regex" CodeLens, so big generated files stay fast. Selecting a pattern still works.

regexPreview.timeoutMs.description: Time limit for one match run, in milliseconds. A pattern that takes longer (catastrophic backtracking) is stopped and the panel says so.

regexPreview.maxSampleMB.description: When a file is used as sample text, only its first part up to this size is read.

regexPreview.maxMatchRows.description: How many matches the table lists. All matches are still counted.

regexPreview.defaultFlags.description: Flags for a new pattern typed in the panel.

regexPreview.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after you have used Regex Preview in two sessions. You can answer "Later" or "No thanks". Nothing is sent anywhere.

regexPreview.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, More free viewers and Sponsor links at the bottom of the panel. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Regex Preview
walkthroughs.description: Test the regexes in your code on your own text, with groups, replace and a railroad diagram. No account, no network.

steps.title: Click "Test regex" in your code
steps.description:
Open a JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Ruby or Rust file. A "Test regex" link shows above each regex. In any other file, select a pattern and run "Test Selected Text as Regex".
[Open the panel](command:regexPreview.open)

steps.title: Your own sample text
steps.description:
Type or paste text in the panel; it is kept for this workspace. "Load file" uses a log or data file, even a large one.
[Use a file as sample text](command:regexPreview.useFileAsSample)

steps.title: Diagram, explain and flavors
steps.description: The Diagram tab draws a railroad diagram (export SVG or PNG). Explain lists each part in plain words. Pick Python, Java, .NET, Go or PCRE to see syntax that differs from JavaScript.
